0.0: It's been a while since you've yutted it up, hasn't it?
0.1: Of course, you're already familiar with the Game of Yut...\r\nWHAT!? You've never heard of it?! My mind is blown!
0.2: Listen close! On our turn, you'll cast the yut sticks. You'll move your piece depending on which yuts you get. There are 5 possibilities: #eDo, Gae, Gul, Yut, Mo#n. The first player to score with all 4 game pieces wins.
0.3:
Strategy 1! Have your pieces piggy back on each other.
Strategy 2! Catch your opponent's pieces.
Strategy 3! Get to the corners to take the shortcut.
You'll pick it up once you try it out. It's easy.
